as_told.title: RAND contact tracking convergence of quantum, AI and Grusch UFO claims

plain: Around 2023, a well-placed national security insider is said to have summed up what really mattered as a triangle: "AI, quantum, and the Grusch stuff," meaning the claims of David Grusch, a former Air Force intelligence officer who testified that the US holds craft not made by humans. The national security analyst Matthew Pines tells it as something said to him, and Michels repeats it on several later episodes, placing the speaker variously at AARO (the Pentagon office that studies unexplained aerial reports), at the CIA, at the Pentagon, or at the RAND Corporation, and once calling it an "iron triangle." If true, it would mean insiders rank the UFO question alongside AI and quantum computing as a top strategic concern.
